# Worker env

- Prove a change with tests and typecheck first. They are faster and need no running app.
- Start an env only to see the UI, QA a flow end to end, or reproduce behavior that only shows at runtime.
- Run `pnpm worker up`. It is idempotent: when this checkout already runs an env, it prints that env instead of starting another. It prints the URLs.
- Open the printed `(browser)` origin in any browser. Every env has its own origin, so cookies and storage never mix.
- Logs are in `.worker/`: `<service>.log`, `install.log`, `setup.log`, `supervisor.log`, and `runtime.json` for the ports and status.
- Never touch the owner env or the shared containers (databases, caches, search). Use only the URLs `pnpm worker up` printed.
- Never clean up: do not run `pnpm worker down`, kill processes or drop databases. Envs stop on their own when idle.
